checks: native raw minus and unconfirmed notes persist through normal Close without changing combat
fresh Electron process restores the raw fighter and note drafts from SQLite
explicit fighter submit consumes only its exact draft and preserves the separate note draft
explicit note submit adopts and consumes the independent note draft
instrumentation: Own temporary SQLite/userData seeded before launch; actual unmodified Main/preload/renderer, two Electron processes and native text fields. No substituted IPC responses.
limits: Small Linux normal Close/Fresh and explicit-adoption path; not hard-crash, screenreader, large drafts, IME or cross-platform acceptance.
